gen-gf-goldman-fs-bespoke-slab: Goldman spreads its letters wide, with round forms curving like open parentheses and a lowercase that towers over its capitals. Bespoke Slab answers with tall, grounded lowercase bodies, built for reading where Goldman is built for announcing.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-erode: Erode has a tall middle band and short ascenders and descenders.  Its stroke weight ebbs gently through every curve, so if Goldman's wide, commanding heading were made small, it would lose its swagger while Erode would hold up at nearly any size.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-hoover: Wide, brash and confident up top. Goldman's generous letterspacing and parenthesis-round forms push forward, while Hoover's compressed ascenders and open e keep the text below sturdy and refined, like a firm handshake after a loud hello.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-trench-slab: Goldman's round forms bend like open parentheses. Trench Slab keeps its lowercase almost as tall as its capitals, so a long passage in that serif feels dense, dignified and steady beneath the heading's bold stretch.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-domine: Wide and assertive, then settled. Goldman is at its best shouting a few big words with its roomy, round letters, while Domine, a classic serif with compact ascenders and open curves, is at its best carrying paragraphs after them.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-esteban: Esteban reads large and friendly, its oversized lowercase and open e never squeezed shut. Make Goldman's wide heading small and its commanding presence thins out, whereas Esteban, a classic serif, carries on happily at modest sizes.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-faustina: Faustina reads with quiet authority, its bowls thinning gently and its c opening like a pair of pliers. Goldman's wide, bold shapes meet that text serif with real force, and the gap between them is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-halant: Halant towers with a stubby, sturdy x-height, and its faint thick-thin shifts give the serif a traditional, authoritative tone. Goldman earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-headland-one: Dignified describes Headland One, with well-spaced letters and a tall round o that nearly matches its capital. And Goldman, wide and bold, does its best work up front in a few commanding words, while the classic serif handles everything after.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Hedvig Letters Serif reads sturdy and open, with tall lowercase and curves that have room to breathe. Goldman's widely set, parenthesis-round heading makes a bold contrast, so give the heading generous size and let the classic serif settle below it.
